actions.description: Patch selected Microsoft Entra profile fields when SuccessFactors sends an employee-updated event.

scriptedVariables.name: sfEventType
scriptedVariables.script: const root=scope?.payload&&typeof scope.payload==='object'?scope.payload:scope;const read=(...paths)=>{for(const path of paths){const value=path.split('.').reduce((obj,key)=>obj==null?undefined:obj[key],root);if(value!==undefined&&value!==null&&String(value).trim()!=='')return value;}return '';};const raw=String(read('eventType','event_type','type','action','operation','event.reason')||'').toLowerCase();if(raw.includes('update')||raw==='change'||raw==='employee.updated')return 'employee.updated';return raw;

scriptedVariables.script: const root=scope?.payload&&typeof scope.payload==='object'?scope.payload:scope;const read=(...paths)=>{for(const path of paths){const value=path.split('.').reduce((obj,key)=>obj==null?undefined:obj[key],root);if(value!==undefined&&value!==null&&String(value).trim()!=='')return value;}return '';};const direct=read('displayName','employee.displayName','userNav.displayName','person.displayName');if(direct)return direct;return [read('firstName','givenName','employee.firstName'),read('lastName','surname','employee.lastName')].filter(Boolean).join(' ')||read('employeeId','personIdExternal','userId')||'Employee';
